In the heat of combat there are no rules keepers, just victors and corpses.

Before rolling Vital Strike damage dice on an attack, you can forgo rolling some of the Vital Strike damage dice to add an effect to one target hit by the attack instead. If you have enough Vital Strike dice to spend, you can apply multiple effects as part of one Vital Strike.

After rolling for damage on an attack, you can use the following table to reduce the final damage in order to either make the target save against a condition, or automatically apply a condition to your target. Unless listed as indefinite, Cheap Shot conditions apply until the end of your next turn.
